Class FqzcompNx16Z.EncodeOptions

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.codecs.FqzcompNx16Z.EncodeOptions
Enclosing class:
FqzcompNx16Z
public static final class FqzcompNx16Z.EncodeOptions extends Object
Encoder options bag. Currently exposes a single knob: preferNative(boolean) — when true (and the native library is available), FqzcompNx16Z.encode(byte[], int[], int[]) emits a V2 wire format with body produced by libttio_rans's ttio_rans_encode_block. When false, the V1 path is forced (default behaviour, byte-identical to historical encoders). When this method is never called (or the native library is unavailable), the encoder consults the environment variable TTIO_M94Z_USE_NATIVE — values "1", "true", "yes", "on" (case-insensitive) enable V2 dispatch.

V2 encode is fast (native rANS); V2 decode is pure-Java because contexts are derived from previously-decoded symbols (see Task 21/22 design notes — the C library's decode requires a fully pre-computed contexts vector). V1 streams continue to round-trip via the existing pure-Java path.
